data.narrative:
Skyroot Aerospace is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $160M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 6 private peers in the same sector and stage cohort, including Sierra Space, Apex Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, and Aalyria, as well as 5 public space and aerospace comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $160M total raised as a base proxy and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, implies a valuation of $272M. Peer-median analysis across the 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables yields a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range of $1.15B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple is not applicable, as Skyroot's revenue is not disclosed. The public sector median P/S of 27.4x cannot be applied without this data.

Synthesis of the two applicable methods produces a triangulated range of $231M (low) to $2.1B (high), with a median of $1.0B. The wide range reflects material dispersion in peer valuations and methodological gap between stage-progression and peer-median approaches. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to peers, technology validation stage, and whether Skyroot's capital efficiency and market position justify positioning toward the peer median rather than the stage-progression estimate.
